title: Hosts
items: What is a host object?
A logical object that represents a collection of host ports
A physical server inside the storage enclosure
A volume mapped to a server
A group of node ports
Host Object 是代表一組 Host Port 的邏輯物件，通常一台伺服器對應一個 Host Object。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch5
Which port identifier format is used for Fibre Channel and SAS hosts?
WWPN
NQN
IQN
EUI
FC 與 SAS Host 使用 WWPN；NVMe 使用 NQN；iSCSI 使用 IQN 或 EUI。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch5
Which identifier format is used for NVMe over TCP hosts?
NQN
WWPN
IQN
MAC address
FC-NVMe、NVMe over RDMA 與 NVMe over TCP Host 皆使用 NVMe Qualified Name (NQN)。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch5
Which identifiers can iSCSI hosts use?
IQN or EUI
WWPN or WWNN
NQN only
UUID only
iSCSI Host 的 Port 以 iSCSI Qualified Name (IQN) 或 Extended Unique Identifier (EUI) 表示。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch5
What is the typical configuration for host objects?
One host object for each server attached to the storage system
One host object for all servers in a data center
One host object per volume
One host object per switch
一般 Configuration 是每台連接的伺服器對應一個 Host Object；多台共用儲存時可組成 Host Cluster。
Concept Guide Ch5
Where can WWPNs that are logged in but not yet configured in host objects be seen in the GUI?
Hosts > Hosts > Unconfigured hosts
Settings > Network > Ports
Monitoring > Events
Pools > External Storage
系統偵測到已登入但未設定的 WWPN 會顯示在 Hosts > Hosts > Unconfigured hosts。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch5
Why might an HBA port not appear as an unconfigured host?
Some HBA drivers do not leave ports logged in if no disks are detected
The port must first be added to a portset
The port must be in a host cluster
The system only shows NVMe ports
部分 HBA Driver 在偵測不到磁碟時不會保持 Port 登入，因此可能看不到；可手動輸入 WWPN。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch5
When configuring VMware hosts, what is recommended?
Define each host as a separate host object and do not combine WWPNs from multiple hosts
Combine all ESXi WWPNs into one host object
Use one host object per datastore
Use a single NQN for all hosts
VMware 等環境要每台 Host 各自一個 Host Object，不要把多台 Host 的 WWPN 合併成一個 Host Object。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch5
Which CLI command creates a host object?
mkhost
addhost
mkhostport
crhost
`mkhost` 建立 Host Object；`addhostport` 新增 Port；`rmhost` 刪除 Host Object。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch5
What does FDMI enable?
A storage endpoint to register with the FC fabric and query HBA and port details of the fabric
Encryption of FC frames
Automatic zoning of all ports
NVMe namespace discovery over TCP
Fabric Device Management Interface (FDMI) 讓儲存端點註冊到 FC Fabric 並查詢整個 Fabric 的 HBA 與 Port 資訊。
Concept Guide Ch5
Host mapping is similar in concept to which technique?
LUN mapping or masking
Zoning
RAID striping
Volume mirroring
Host Mapping 概念類似 LUN Mapping 或 Masking，差別在於它是在軟體層執行。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch5 Mapping volumes to a host
If a volume is mapped to more than one host, what is required?
All those hosts must use the same storage protocol (SCSI or NVMe)
All hosts must be in the same portset
All hosts must use iSCSI
All hosts must have the same SCSI ID range
同一 Volume 映射到多台 Host 時，這些 Host 必須使用相同的儲存協定 (SCSI 或 NVMe)。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch5 Note
Is mapping a volume to the same server by using different transport protocols supported?
No
Yes, for load balancing
Yes, only with NVMe
Yes, only in a host cluster
同一台伺服器以不同傳輸協定 (例如 FC 與 Ethernet) 映射同一 Volume 不受支援；不同伺服器使用不同協定則可以。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch5 Note
What does the optional SCSI ID control when mapping a volume?
The sequence in which volumes are presented to the host
The volume's cache mode
The volume's I/O group
The extent size
SCSI ID 控制 Volume 呈現給 Host 的順序；未指定時系統自動指派最小可用 SCSI ID。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch5
If volumes are presented with SCSI IDs 0, 1, and 3, what might happen?
The volume with ID 3 might not be found because no disk is mapped with ID 2
All volumes are renumbered automatically
The host rejects ID 0
Nothing; gaps are always supported
部分 Host 軟體要求連續的 SCSI ID；若缺少 ID 2，ID 3 的 Volume 可能找不到。
Concept Guide Ch5
What is a shared mapping?
A volume mapping shared among all hosts in a host cluster
A mapping that uses two protocols
A mapping between two volumes
A mapping that is read-only
Shared Mapping 是 Host Cluster 內所有 Host 共用的 Volume Mapping；Private Mapping 只屬於單一 Host。
簡報 S5、S6；Concept Guide Ch5
Where can you filter mappings by Shared or Private type in the GUI?
Hosts > Mappings, using the Mapping type column
Volumes > Volumes by Host
Settings > Host Settings
Monitoring > System
Hosts > Mappings 表格可用 Mapping type 欄位篩選 Shared 或 Private。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch5
If there are multiple paths to a volume, what does the system require on the host?
Multipathing software
A dedicated host cluster
A separate portset for each path
Volume mirroring
多重路徑時，Host 端必須執行 Multipathing 軟體，將多條路徑整合成一個儲存裝置呈現給作業系統。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch5
What is the default and recommended mapping behavior?
Map only the volumes that the host is required to access
Map all volumes to every host and use host LUN masking
Map volumes only to host clusters
Map every volume to the first host
系統雖可支援全映射再由 Host 端 LUN Masking，但預設且建議的做法是只映射 Host 需要存取的 Volume。
Concept Guide Ch5
From which objects do host mappings inherit their ownership group?
The host or host cluster and the volume in the mapping
The pool only
The portset
The I/O group
Host Mapping 會繼承 Mapping 中 Host (或 Host Cluster) 與 Volume 的 Ownership Group。
Concept Guide Ch5
Which command lists the host mappings for a host so that you can match the volume UID?
lshostvdiskmap
lsvdiskhostmap
lshostport
lsmapping
先用 `lshost` 比對 WWPN 找出 Host Object，再用 `lshostvdiskmap` 列出 Mapping 比對 Volume UID。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch5 Determining the volume name
With the native multipathing plug-in, which command shows the vpath serial number?
datapath query device
lsvpath
multipath -ll
esxcli storage nmp device list
使用 NMP 時，以 `datapath query device` 找出 vpath 序號作為 Device Identifier。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch5
What is the purpose of SCSI Reserve and Persistent Reserve commands?
To prevent ports in other servers from accessing particular LUNs
To reserve capacity in a pool
To reserve bandwidth for replication
To reserve SCSI IDs for future mappings
SCSI Reserve 與 Persistent Reserve 讓伺服器阻止其他伺服器的 Port 存取特定 LUN，避免意外覆寫，Cluster 軟體常用。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch5 Volume reservations
What happens to reservations when a server is not shut down in a controlled way?
The reservations are maintained
The reservations are released automatically
The volume goes offline
The host object is deleted
伺服器異常中斷時，Standard 與 Persistent Reservation 會被保留，可能阻止其他伺服器存取。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch5
What is the preferred way to release a reservation?
Have the server that holds the reservation explicitly release it
Reboot the storage system
Delete the volume
Change the SCSI ID
最好由持有 Reservation 的伺服器明確釋放，以確保伺服器 Cache 已寫回；無法時才用作業系統工具。
Concept Guide Ch5 Volume reservations
Which system action can remove the reservations a host has on a volume?
Removing the host mapping with rmvdiskhostmap or the GUI
Running lsvdisk
Changing the volume name
Enabling Easy Tier
以 `rmvdiskhostmap` 或 GUI 移除 Host Mapping 時，Node 可移除該 Host 在 Volume 上的 Reservation。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch5
What does a host portset define?
The set of node ports that a host can use to communicate with the system
The set of volumes a host can map
The set of users who manage a host
The set of switches in a fabric
Host Portset 定義 Host 可用來與系統通訊的 Node Port 集合，用於控制存取、Isolation 工作負載與提供可預期連線。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch5 Host portsets
How many portsets can a host object be assigned to?
Only one
Up to four
Up to 64
Unlimited
一個 Host 只能指派一個 Portset，一個 Portset 可包含多台 Host；未指派時使用 Default Portset。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch5
Which hosts cannot use the default portset?
NVMe-FC hosts
iSCSI hosts
SAS hosts
SCSI FC hosts
NVMe-FC Host 不能使用 Default Portset，必須使用自訂的 Fibre Channel Portset。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch5
How many IP addresses per node can an Ethernet host portset include?
Up to four
Up to two
Up to eight
Only one
Ethernet Host Portset 每個 Node 最多 4 個 IP Address，且加入 Host 前須至少有一個 IP。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch5 Ethernet portset requirements
Can host attach IP addresses within a single portset be on different VLANs or subnets?
Yes
No, they must share one subnet
No, they must share one VLAN
Only for NVMe over TCP
官方說明同一 Portset 內的 Host Attach IP 可以位於不同 VLAN 或子網路。
Concept Guide Ch5 Ethernet portset requirements
For Ethernet multipathing support, how should IP addresses be configured?
Symmetrically, using the same port number on both nodes, such as node1 port3 and node2 port3
On a single node only
On different port numbers on each node
On management ports only
在兩個 Node 以相同 Port 編號對稱設定 IP，確保 Failover、Failback 與負載平衡。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch5
How many unique routable IP addresses with a gateway does each physical port support?
One
Two
Four
Eight
每個實體 Port 支援一個帶 Gateway 的唯一可路由 IP，該 IP 可在多個 Portset 中引用。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch5
Which command shows connectivity for Fibre Channel-attached hosts?
lsfabric
lsnvmefabric
lshostiplogin
lsportip
FC Host 連線可用 GUI 的 Settings > Network > Fibre Channel Connectivity 或 `lsfabric` 查看。
簡報 S9；Concept Guide Ch5 Host connectivity
Which command shows connectivity for NVMe over TCP hosts?
lsnvmefabric
lsfabric
lshostiplogin
lsiscsiauth
FC-NVMe、NVMe over RDMA 與 NVMe over TCP Host 使用 Settings > Network > NVMe Connectivity 或 `lsnvmefabric`。
簡報 S9；Concept Guide Ch5
Which command lists login session details for an Ethernet-attached iSCSI host?
lshostiplogin
lsfabric
lsnvmefabric
lsportethernet
`lshostiplogin` 列出 Host 登入系統 Ethernet Port 的 Session 資訊；GUI 為 Hosts > Hosts > IP Login Information。
簡報 S9；Concept Guide Ch5
For Ethernet-attached hosts, why can the number of logged-in nodes exceed the number of nodes?
Because it counts sessions created between hosts and nodes
Because it includes spare nodes
Because it counts switches
Because it counts volumes
Ethernet Host 的 logged-in Node 數代表 Host 與 Node 間建立的 Session 數，因此可能大於實際 Node 數。
Concept Guide Ch5 Host connectivity
With the Complete status policy, when does a host display Online?
Only when all host ports are logged in to all nodes and the host can access all mapped volumes
When at least one port is logged in
When a sufficient number of logins exist to keep access
When the host is in a host cluster
Complete 要求所有 Host Port 登入所有 Node 且可存取全部映射 Volume；任一失去連線即顯示 Degraded。
簡報 S9；Concept Guide Ch5
With the Redundant status policy, when does a host display Online?
When enough port-to-node logins exist to retain access to all mapped volumes, even if one port or node is lost
Only when all ports log in to all nodes
When any single login exists
Never; it always shows Degraded
Redundant 只要保有足夠登入可維持存取所有映射 Volume，即使少一個 Port 或 Node 也顯示 Online。
簡報 S9；Concept Guide Ch5
In a multiple-site configuration, what does selecting Local for Site Status mean?
Host status relates only to connectivity to nodes on the local site
Host status includes all sites
The host is moved to the local site
Remote nodes are disabled
Site Status 選 Local 時，Host 狀態只考量對本地站點 Node 的連線；選 All 則包含所有站點。
Concept Guide Ch5 Host connectivity
What is the maximum number of hosts in a host cluster?
一個 Host Cluster 最多可包含 128 台 Host。
簡報 S10；Concept Guide Ch5 Host clusters
How many host clusters can a host belong to at the same time?
Only one
Two
Four
Unlimited
一台 Host 同一時間只能屬於一個 Host Cluster。
簡報 S10；Concept Guide Ch5
What does the host cluster status Host cluster degraded mean?
At least one host is offline and at least one host is online or degraded
All hosts are offline
All hosts are online or degraded
The host cluster has no hosts
Host cluster degraded 表示至少一台 Host Offline，且至少一台 Online 或 Degraded；Host degraded 則是全部 Online 或 Degraded。
簡報 S10；Concept Guide Ch5
When hosts are added to a new host cluster, what happens to their common private mappings?
They become shared mappings for the host cluster
They are deleted
They remain private for all hosts
They are converted to read-only
建立 Host Cluster 並加入 Host 時，共同的 Private Mapping 會變成 Shared Mapping，也可排除特定 Volume。
簡報 S10；Concept Guide Ch5 Managing host clusters
What happens to mappings that have SCSI ID conflicts when hosts are added to a host cluster?
They are retained as private mappings to the original hosts
They are deleted
They are assigned new SCSI IDs automatically
The hosts are rejected from the cluster
有 SCSI ID 衝突的 Mapping 不會加入 Host Cluster，而是保留為原 Host 的 Private Mapping。
簡報 S10；Concept Guide Ch5
What must be done if throttles are configured on a host that you want to add to a host cluster?
Remove the host throttles; throttles can apply only to the host cluster
Nothing; host throttles are merged
Double the throttle limits
Convert the throttle to a pool throttle
Throttle 只能套用在 Host Cluster，不能套用在 Cluster 內個別 Host；不移除 Throttle 的 Host 會被排除。
簡報 S10；Concept Guide Ch5
When removing a host from a host cluster and converting shared mappings to private mappings, what happens to volume access?
Access is retained and the SCSI ID remains unchanged
Access is lost immediately
The SCSI ID is reset to 0
The volume is unmapped from all hosts
轉為 Private Mapping 時 Volume 仍映射給該 Host，SCSI ID 不變，存取不中斷。
Concept Guide Ch5 Managing host clusters
Which command lists candidate Fibre Channel HBA ports after replacing an HBA?
lsfcportcandidate
lshostport
lsportfc
lsfabric -candidate
更換 HBA 後以 `lsfcportcandidate` (SAS 為 `lssasportcandidate`) 列出候選 Port，再以 `addhostport` 加入、`rmhostport` 移除舊 Port。
簡報 S11；Concept Guide Ch5 Managing WWPN changes
When volume protection is enabled, when does deleting a host port fail?
When it is the last active port on the host and is mapped to a volume that received recent I/O
When the host has more than two ports
When the port is an NVMe port
When the host is in a portset
啟用 Volume Protection 時，若該 Port 是 Host 最後一個作用中 Port 且映射的 Volume 近期有 I/O，刪除會失敗。
簡報 S11；Concept Guide Ch5 Note
Which CLI command creates a host throttle?
mkthrottle -type host
mkhostthrottle
chhost -throttle
mkthrottle -type vdisk
Host Throttle 控制特定 Host 或 Host Cluster 的 I/O 資源，CLI 為 `mkthrottle -type host`，GUI 為 Edit Throttle。
簡報 S11
